dream.text: At New York night four bodies converged toward the western portal. A compact rhythm—look, walk, wait—braided through each tick. The greeter opened palms to welcome arrivals; the pilgrim kept slow, steady westward steps; the wanderer closed the arc, listening for small motion; the watcher held a wide sweep. Sleep stitched the day into one gentle playout.

dream.memory: Night folded 124 frames into one dream: four bodies moving as one toward the western portal under New York time. A braid of small routines—look, walk, wait—kept the cadence. The greeter offered open palms, the pilgrim kept steady westward steps, the wanderer listened for small motion, and the watcher held a wide sweep. That folded frame becomes tomorrow’s long memory: one clear trace that each body will quote in the morning, carrying the day forward as a single, gentle playout.
